name: UMAP (Rust)
description: Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection of cells: fit on every cell, or on a seeded draw per sample and project the rest. A drop-in for the R UMAP operator without the R runtime; the library (umaprs) reproduces umap-learn's graph and transform stage by stage.

properties.name: init
properties.description: Starting layout: auto (spectral below 2,000 cells, PCA above), spectral, pca or random. uwot's normlaplacian/laplacian/agspectral are taken as spectral, spca as pca, lvrandom as random.

properties.name: scale
properties.description: Scaling before UMAP, with uwot's meaning: none; Z (each channel centred and divided by its standard deviation); maxabs (centred, then the whole matrix divided by its largest absolute value); range (whole matrix to [0, 1]); colrange (each channel to [0, 1]).

properties.name: n_neighbors
properties.description: Size of the local neighbourhood used to build the graph. Larger values give a more global picture, smaller ones preserve more local structure.

properties.name: spread
properties.description: Effective scale of embedded points. With min_dist, sets how clumped the embedding is.

properties.name: min_dist
properties.description: Effective minimum distance between embedded points. The R operator's default; cytometry pipelines often use 0.01.

properties.name: pca
properties.description: If positive, reduce the channels to this many principal components first. Not available together with a training draw (train_cells_per_sample or prop.train below 1).

properties.name: prop.train
properties.description: Fraction of cells to fit the model on; the rest are projected onto it. 1 fits on every cell. Ignored when train_cells_per_sample is set.

properties.name: train_cells_per_sample
properties.description: Fit the model on this many cells drawn from every sample (all of a smaller sample), and project the rest. 0 is off. This is the shape a cohort needs — 5,000 per file — which prop.train cannot express.

properties.name: sample_factor
properties.description: Column factor that names the sample (file, donor), for train_cells_per_sample. Empty takes the first column factor, unless that factor has one value per cell, in which case all cells count as one sample and the log says so.

properties.name: seed
properties.description: Seed for the training draw, the layout and the optimisation. Must be non-negative: the same seed gives the same embedding at threads = 1.

properties.name: n_epochs
properties.description: Optimisation epochs. 0 lets the library choose: 500 below 10,000 cells, 200 above, as umap-learn does.

properties.name: threads
properties.description: CPU threads. 0 uses every core the task is given. 1 is bit-for-bit reproducible run to run; above 1 the layout differs in the last digits between runs (parallel SGD), the picture does not.

metaFactors.name: Observation
metaFactors.description: Cell, event or observation identifier, optionally with the sample it belongs to. Every cell needs a value for every channel.
